name: hf
description: huggingface_hub's bundled CLI; the current command name is hf (the old huggingface-cli still works). Subcommands: auth / download / upload / repo / repo-files / cache / jobs / env / version. hf is not in the default allowlist, so add it to AGENTHUB_CLI_ALLOWLIST.

metadata.install: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -U "huggingface_hub[cli]" (or pipx install huggingface_hub)
metadata.env_hint: HF_TOKEN (hf auth login, or an environment variable on the server process)
